description: The policy text in force, detached at sourceRef with public-record retention. Only the name `active` is admissible; admitting it is the activation, and re-admitting it supersedes the previous bundle on the record (supersededBy on the store entry).

claims: the policy text at `sourceRef` was submitted by the recorded actor and admitted under the name `active` at the recorded position on the chain
this bundle governs only the workload Kind paths declared in governs, never kernel or gateway policy-management admissions

the key recorded as the actor signed this request over its canonical bytes, and the authority it cited resolved, link by link, to a root on this same chain — both re-derivable offline from the bundle alone
doesNotClaim: that the policy is correct, complete, or expresses anyone's intent

that whoever set policy was entitled to set it — the record shows which key admitted it and which endorsement chain that key exercised; whether that chain roots in a key worth trusting is the reader's pin to make, never this chain's claim
that any decision recorded under it was enforced outside this kernel's admission gate

that any person, office, or organization holds the key that signed — the record binds the act to a key and the key to the authority it acted under, and neither to anyone; a reader who wants a name pins a root key and owns the pin
